module TopModule (
  input p1a,
  input p1b,
  input p1c,
  input p1d,
  output p1y,
  input p2a,
  input p2b,
  input p2c,
  input p2d,
  output p2y
);

  assign p1y = p1a & p1b & p1c & p1d;
  assign p2y = p2a & p2b & p2c & p2d;

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input a,
  output reg q
);
always @ (posedge clk) begin
  if (a) begin
    q <= #1 1'b1;
  end
  else begin
    q <= #1 1'b0;
  end
end
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  output reg [3:0] q
);
  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
      q <= 4'b0;
    end
    else begin
      q <= {q[2:0], q[3]};
    end
  end
endmodule

    end

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input resetn,
  input [1:0] byteena,
  input [15:0] d,
  output reg [15:0] q
);
always @(posedge clk) begin
  if (!resetn) begin
    q <= 16'd0;
  end else begin
    if (byteena == 2'd0) begin
      q <= d;
    end else begin
      if (byteena == 2'd1) begin
        q <= {q[15:8], d[7:0]};
      end else begin
        if (byteena == 2'd2) begin
          q <= {d[15:8], q[7:0]};
        end else begin
          if (byteena == 2'd3) begin
            q <= {q[15:8], d[7:0]};
          end else begin
            q <= d;
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input [7:0] d,
  input areset,
  output reg [7:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
  if (areset) begin
    q <= 8'h00;
  end
  else begin
    q <= d;
  end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input [7:0] d,
  input reset,
  output reg [7:0] q
);
always @(posedge clk) begin
  if (reset) begin
    q <= 8'h00;
  end
  else begin
    q <= d;
  end
end
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input [7:0] d,
  input reset,
  output reg [7:0] q
);
  always @ (posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
      q <= 8'h0;
    end
    else begin
      q <= (d >> 1) + (d << 1);
    end
  end
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input enable,
  input S,
  input A,
  input B,
  input C,
  output reg Z
);

always @(*) begin
  case (S)
    1'b0: Z = A & B | B & C | A & C;
    1'b1: Z = A ^ B ^ C;
    default: Z = 1'b0;
  endcase
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input aresetn,
  input x,
  output reg z
);
  always @(posedge clk or negedge aresetn) begin
    if (!aresetn) begin
      z <= 1'b0;
    end
    else begin
      z <= x;
    end
  end
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input j,
  input k,
  input reset,
  output out
);
  reg [3:0] Q;
  reg [3:0] D;
  wire [3:0] notJk;
  
  assign notJk = ~({j, k}); //= ( !j | !k ) // This is actually an equivalence operation: j == k
  
  always @ (posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
      Q <= 4'b0000; // set initial values to high
    end
    else if (notJk) begin // j & k both high
      Q <= Q; // Q retains its current value (i.e. toggle is off, so it doesn't change)
    end
    else if (j & k) begin // j & k both high
      Q <= ~Q; // this without using a flip-flop, as per question
    end
  end
  
  assign out = Q;
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [3:0] a,
  input [3:0] b,
  input [3:0] c,
  input [3:0] d,
  input [3:0] e,
  output reg [3:0] q
);
always @* begin
  q = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin
    if (a[i] == b[i] && b[i] == c[i] && c[i] == d[i] && d[i] == e[i]) begin
      q[i] = 1;
    end else begin
      q[i] = 0;
    end
  end
end
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input a,
  output reg [2:0] q
);

always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
  if (a) begin
    q <= {q[2], q[1], q[0] ^ 1};
  end
end

endmodule

  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,

);

  end

  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output reg out
);

    out = (a & c) | (b & c) | (b & d);
  end
endmodule
